text.en:
Criminal Procedure Code
(CHAPTER 68, Section 14(2))
Officers to Whom Persons Subject to Police Supervision Shall Report
N 3
G.N. No. S 312/1991
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
[19th July 1991]
The Commissioner of Police has appointed —
(a)the Officer-in-Charge of the Criminal Record Office, Criminal Investigation Department, to be the officer to whom all persons subject to police supervision shall report on their release from Prison; and
(b)the Heads of Investigations of the Police Divisions in which such persons reside to be the officers to whom such persons shall report thereafter.
